sourceSummary: Port Vale current 2026/27 identity selection cross-checked against the committed FootballSquads roster/DOB source and detailed current or last-published role/value evidence. Snapshot-date birthdays are normalized, broad identity groups are refined to SWOS roles, and unavailable published values are encoded as 0 rather than estimated.
